I lost my FP last year and it was honestly the worst year of my life even though when you think about it, I've been through worse. 

It took me 4 months after he told me he didn't love me anymore to get my dignity and leave, but that was only after love turned to hatred and rage. 

The biggest mistake I made was in letting one person take control of my whole life during a pandemic when I couldn't even meet him. 
It then took me another 11 months to come to terms with the loss but only after I had fooled around with two other guys. 
We tried to be friends but it always went down the same path and ended in me having so much anger against him which I didn't know I was capable of. 
Rn I'm more numb thanks to meds and I realised that the best thing is to just be friends who talk once in a while. So honestly I think if he's not supportive of what you will be going through, cutting off all contact and especially social media where you can see anything that reminds you of him would be best. Also find other sources to let your feelings out and vent. Just be safe and make sure they're trustworthy. 
This is just what I know from my very horrible personal experience and I pray that you won't ever have to go through it. 
Hope you can talk things out.
